T1053.long: Utilities such as at and schtasks, along with the Windows Task Scheduler, can be used to schedule programs or scripts to be executed at a date and time. A task can also be scheduled on a remote system, provided the proper authentication is met to use RPC and file and printer sharing is turned on. Scheduling a task on a remote system typically required being a member of the Administrators group on the the remote system.

strings: DONGGUANG ITM-LAB MACHINE INC. was established in 1998 and the company is headquartered in Dongguan City, Guangdong Province. For 23 years, we have been focusing on product reliability testing and automated testing, specializing in the research and development, production, sales and maintenance of various testing machines. Suitable for mechanical testing, packaging testing, furniture testing, electronic and electrical testing, rubber industry.

If you have real-time requirements for the test equipment, please write to us. We are the best candidate for your global business
Looking forward to hearing from you soon.
